title: Poland's Land
text:
Poland is in Europe. It has mountains in the south and a long coast on the sea in the north. The capital city is Warsaw. The Vistula is a long river in Poland.

The Vistula flows through Warsaw and Kraków. Many people go to the mountains in winter to ski. The Baltic Sea is cold, but people swim there in summer. The land is green and flat in the middle of the country.

questions.text: What is the capital city of Poland?
Where do many people ski in winter?
Why do people swim in the sea in summer?
options: Because the sea is in the mountains

questions.text: What can we guess about the Vistula?
options: It is only in the mountains

vocabulary.definition: a large amount of water that flows across the land to the sea
the main city of a country, where the government works
a large area of salt water

paragraph_translations: Polska leży w Europie. Ma góry na południu i długie wybrzeże nad morzem na północy. Stolica to Warszawa. Wisła to długa rzeka w Polsce.

Wisła płynie przez Warszawę i Kraków. Wiele osób jeździ w góry zimą, aby jeździć na nartach. Morze Bałtyckie jest zimne, ale ludzie pływają w nim latem. Ziemia jest zielona i płaska w środkowej części kraju.
